scoreboard_title: A quiet week on the watchlist, but Paragon lost TikTok share
movers_title: Nothing moved beyond normal; here is what came closest

actions.title: Win back TikTok share with a payday-to-7.7 push
actions.detail: Paragon's share of TikTok posts fell from 26.0% to 20.8%, below its own normal range, while rivals held still. Run a Wardah and Make Over creator wave from payday into 7.7, with cart links on every post.
actions.based_on: Appendix · Paragon TikTok share of posts

actions.title: Shift Nano slots into Mid-tier creators
actions.detail: Nano is 81% of Paragon's creator posts but 20% of its views; Mid-tier is 5% of posts and 46% of views, at a 16K median per post against 618 for Nano. Move part of the Nano budget to Mid-tier for the 7.7 wave.

actions.title: Test one big creator on Make Over's base line
actions.detail: One post can carry a week: @nadiyarawil gave Timephoria 47% of its views, and a Mega post earns a 270K median. Book one Macro or Mega creator for Make Over's base line before 7.7 and track the week's views.

actions.title: Give Emina's next launch one seeding tag
actions.detail: Glad2Glow's #loosepowderg2g put 74 accounts behind one powder, and its powder posts drew 15.9M views. Give Emina's next launch a single tag and a one-post brief per creator, so each wave reads as one number.

actions.title: Post fewer, bigger TikToks from brand accounts
actions.detail: Paragon's 385 brand-account TikToks drew 7.9M views at a 4K median; Hanasui's 37 drew 5.8M at a 41K median, 67% of its TikTok views. Cut the weakest daily posts and back two or three hero videos a week.

portfolio_note: Paragon's share of TikTok posts fell from 26.0% to 20.8%; Instaperfect's TikTok views rose from 53K to 2.8M.

tiers.title: Two Macro posts gave Hanasui 42% of its creator views
tiers.takeaway: Paragon's Mid-tier is 5% of creator posts and 46% of views, while Nano is 81% of posts for 20%. A Mid-tier post earns a 16K median.

products.title: Glad2Glow's powder and Timephoria's skin tint win on few posts
products.takeaway: Glad2Glow's 88 powder posts drew 15.9M views and Timephoria's 19 skin tint posts 12.8M; Paragon's 425 lip posts drew 3.0M.

posting.title: Payday, not a double date, drove this week's promo peak
posting.takeaway: Promo captions peaked at 71 posts on 24 Jun, the run-up to payday; Paragon wrote 94 payday captions and Glad2Glow 26.
